caption: The drawing features a single fork, positioned diagonally across the page, with the handle at the upper left and the tines at the lower right. The handle of the fork is colored in shades of brown and has a wood-like texture, with two small, round, gold-colored rivets visible along the length. There are silver metal sections at both the top and bottom of the handle, connecting it to the metal portion of the fork. The fork's neck and tines are rendered in a gray metallic tone. The fork has four tines. The background is plain, off-white, and the drawing is bordered by a simple rectangular line. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Steel Fork
